fields.description: Greencrest is an apartment development beside the golf landscape of Dubai Hills Estate. Emaar offers one to three bedroom homes with balconies and terraces. The official plans distinguish a taller Block A from a lower Block B, giving buyers a meaningful choice of floor level, outlook and outdoor-space proportions.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children’s play areas

overview: The brochure combines neutral interiors with facilities for exercise, play and meeting neighbours. Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park, the golf course and King’s College Hospital appear in its neighbourhood context. A golf-facing setting does not guarantee the same view from every apartment, so the unit’s orientation matters.
research.locationNote: The project brochure places Greencrest within Dubai Hills Estate, with Al Khail Road and Umm Suqeim Street shown on its local map. GEMS International School, Dubai Hills Mall, the park and King’s College Hospital are nearby destinations. Check the route and travel time for the selected building rather than treating the marketing map as a walking-distance promise.
research.priceNote: Emaar currently displays units from AED 1,743,888 while retaining an earlier AED 1.57 million starting-price statement. The published unit figure is used here as a dated reference; it is not a guarantee of remaining stock or a specific view or floor.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder and Bayut report 10% at booking, 70% during construction and 20% on handover. The split below is portal-reported. Ask for the current dated schedule for the chosen unit, including any charges outside the purchase price.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports June 2029 and Bayut reports Q2 2029. These references agree, but the reviewed developer page and brochure do not confirm a contractual completion date. The quarter shown remains a reported target.
